text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller says government revamps state security courts in order to improve Turkey's bad human rights record.
- The summit between American deputy foreign minister and the rival Kurdish leaders Massoud Barzani and Jalal Talabani will be held in Ankara.
- Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan says his Welfare Party might go into alliance with their current coalition partners of the True Path Party in next elections.
- The support of two women deputies from the conservative wing of the coalition given to a motion aiming to bring down the government wins wide praise.
- Greece cancels a meetings to be held in Turkey on bi-lateral cooperation in the tourism sector.
- Natural gas prices went up by 159 percent since last year.
- Plan to facilitate pilgramages to Mecca will generate huge amounts of money for Islamiat Welfare Party figures.
- Turkish Galatasaray soccer team defeated one of Europe's most powerful teams, Paris Saint Germain.
